channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Nvidia's Huang diverges with CEOs of Anthropic, OpenAI on AI safety at Dreamforce
item.description: Comments from the two tech leaders landed days after Anthropic's Dario Amodei published an essay urging the AI industry to slow the pace of model development.

item.title: Iran war has cost on average $246 million per day in its first five months, CBO finds
item.description: The Congressional Budget Office calculated the Defense Department's Iran war cost through Aug. 1 at $38.1 billion.

item.title: Trump says Kennedy Center will stay closed without renovation unless his name is added back
item.description: The ruling comes four months after the same judge ordered that the Kennedy Center could not be renamed to include President Trump's name.

item.title: Stocks post back-to-back losses as oil surges, 10-year yield hits 19-year high: Live updates
item.description: The major averages closed lower on Monday as higher bond yields and oil prices kept the market under pressure.

item.title: U.S. oil tops $105 as Saudi Arabia reportedly cancels some crude cargoes after pipeline closure
item.description: Iran-backed Houthi militants in Yemen, meanwhile, carried out renewed strikes on Saudi Arabia this week.

item.title: Senate cloture vote on Clarity Act fails, dealing regulatory blow to crypto industry
item.description: The Senate on Tuesday voted to block the Clarity Act from advancing, dealing a blow to the crypto industry's push for a comprehensive market framework.

item.title: Adjusting capital gains for inflation could prove a mess for individual investors
item.description: The notion of indexing capital gains for inflation sounds attractive, but the execution could be burdensome.

item.title: Saudi pipeline closure is a brief interruption that will last days, U.S. Energy secretary tells CNBC
item.description: The Saudis closed the East-West pipeline after it sustained damage in a drone attack launched from Iraq.

item.title: Americans' incomes rose and poverty fell in 2025, Census Bureau says
item.description: The data comes as the Federal Reserve is considering interest-rate increases that could slow economic growth.

item.title: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic discussing collaboration on AI safety issues
item.description: Discussions have been ongoing since Google's Demis Hassabis released a proposal in July calling for a U.S.-led "Standards Body," the spokesperson said.

item.title: Will AI really destroy humanity? Pioneers who created the tech weigh in
item.description: AI pioneers and "godfathers" have weighed in on Anthropic and OpenAI researcher concerns over existential safety risks around the technology.

item.title: U.S. confirms for first time it has weapons deployed in space
item.description: U.S. Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said Monday that the U.S. has "on-orbit space control weapons," as he outlined a broader push to modernize the Air Force.

item.title: Republican Rep. Massie seeks Hegseth's impeachment over Iran
item.description: Republican Rep. Thomas Massie filed articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth for executing Iran war orders without Congress' approval.

item.title: Beaten-up bond market may be nearing 'escape velocity.' Here's what that means
item.description: Rising yields across the bond market have spooked investors, but the surge from zero interest rates since Covid suggests fixed-income risk-reward has improved.

item.title: AWS says it can't restore service to Bahrain, UAE facilities 6 months after Iran strikes
item.description: In March, two Amazon data centers in the UAE were struck by drones, while a site was also damaged by a nearby drone hit.

item.title: This AI play has an unshakeable moat, but has flown under the radar
item.description: Investors who want to benefit from the AI boom maybe overlooking this stock, which is poised to double its revenue in the next three to four years.

item.title: Trump Account contributions have a Dec. 31 deadline — and employers can complicate the math
item.description: Employers can offer Trump Account employee benefits via direct contributions or by allowing workers to make pre-tax contributions to a child's account.

item.title: Trump admin. says private sector can solve AI threats as critics balk
item.description: President Donald Trump's AI-friendly administration argues U.S. dominance over China in the fast-expanding industry is essential.

item.title: AI skeptics from Bernie Sanders to Steve Bannon urge action, as Congress, Trump idle
item.description: Lawmakers and AI regulation advocates met Tuesday in Washington at a Future of Life Institute event to urge regulatory action to rein in the expanding technology.

item.title: Musk urges top AI labs, Chinese companies to test each other's models amid calls for slowdown
item.description: Elon Musk called for the leading AI labs to peer review each others' models before they're released to the public as a way to evaluate their safety.

item.title: Wells Fargo sees improvement in a key metric — plus, Lilly gets praise beyond GLP-1s
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: I tested AI to save money on travel. Here’s what actually worked — and the tools I recommend
item.description: I found AI-powered tools work best for price tracking and efficiently planning your trip.

item.title: Ford increases V-8 engine availability, lowers performance prices for 2027 F-150 trucks
item.description: Ford said the changes are meant to provide customers with more choice and help expand sales of key models, a strategy CEO Jim Farley has touted.

item.description: These are the stocks posting the largest moves midday.

item.title: No one and done: The Fed will hike at least two times over the next year, according to CNBC survey
item.description: While higher oil is cited as a main reason for the change in view, roughly three-quarters of respondents see the inflation problem as broader than just energy prices.

item.title: Trump calls Supreme Court mail ballot ruling 'big loss for Republicans'
item.description: President Trump blasted his three Supreme Court appointees for blocking a Postal Service rule that would have allowed mail-in ballots in November's elections.

item.title: Nike co-founder Phil Knight to donate $1.1 billion to Oregon medical center
item.description: The gift to Providence St. Vincent Medical Center will support the creation of an all-women’s hospital as well as advance cardiovascular care across Oregon.

item.title: Iranian foreign minister will head to China for talks, as Pentagon reveals financial cost of war
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will visit China on Wednesday for talks, Beijing's foreign ministry announced on Tuesday.

item.title: Treasury yields are hovering above a critical threshold. Here's what it means for stocks
item.description: Stocks sold off on Tuesday as the yield on the 10-year Treasury broke above 5%.

item.title: Oil and Treasury yields haven’t moved this closely in seven years. That’s bad news for markets
item.description: Oil and 10-year Treasury yields are moving in near lockstep, with their correlation at its strongest since 2019.
